desc: Ideation and approach selection: choose rolling left-boundary iterative DFS as the primary linear-time approach.
Implement the rolling left-boundary iterative DFS solution in the starter code with adjacency list, enter/exit events, path stacks, last-occurrence rollback, and answer tie-breaking.
Verify the implementation on the provided examples and edge cases (all unique, all same values, chain, star, variable edge lengths) and confirm no recursion is used.
